app.name: Lumora
app.tagline: Your smart assistant for tomorrow's inspiration
app.slogan: We elevate the teacher, to elevate the nation.

students.title: My students
students.intro: Record grades and submissions; Lumora points out what is worth following up.
students.name: Name
students.deleteBody: The student and their records stay restorable for 30 days. After that the data is permanently removed. Nothing is deleted from any other source.
students.privacyModeHint: Shows students as codes instead of names — useful when sharing your screen.
students.empty: You have not added any students yet.
students.emptyHint: Add a student, then record grades and submissions so the analysis has something to work with.

alerts.aiNote: Generated by AI from recorded data; you decide what to do.

insights.title: Class insights

insights.noData: Not enough grades recorded yet to draw out any insights.
insights.sensitivityHint: How many percentage points counts as a drop worth alerting on (default 20).
